categories.main_business_segments: SiteOne operates as a single reportable segment, serving as the largest and only national full product line wholesale distributor of landscape supplies in the United States, with a growing presence in Canada. Its offerings include irrigation supplies, fertilizer and control products, hardscapes, landscape accessories, nursery goods, outdoor lighting, and ice melt products, complemented by value-added consultative services for landscape professionals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations center on wholesale distribution, leveraging a network of over 690 branches and a fleet of 2,800+ delivery vehicles. SiteOne utilizes an integrated technology platform for procurement, inventory management, delivery, and analytics, and offers proprietary branded products (LESCO, SiteOne Green Tech, Pro-Trade, Portfolio, Solstice) with some in-house formulation and packaging, especially for fertilizers and specialty chemicals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SiteOne’s primary customers are residential and commercial landscape professionals, including contractors specializing in design, installation, and maintenance of outdoor spaces, as well as golf courses and municipal agencies. The company serves over 430,000 customers, with a balanced mix across residential (61% of sales), commercial/institutional (31%), and recreational/other (8%) construction sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: SiteOne operates in 45 U.S. states and six Canadian provinces, with over 690 branch locations and four major U.S. distribution centers. The company’s footprint covers approximately 50% of U.S. metropolitan statistical areas and is expanding through acquisitions and organic growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: SiteOne is a downstream distributor, acting as an intermediary between approximately 5,800 suppliers (including major manufacturers) and landscape professionals. The company provides both local branch-based distribution and direct bulk logistics, offering value-added services such as inventory management and project planning.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding geographic and product reach through organic growth and acquisitions, enhancing digital and e-commerce capabilities, improving supply chain efficiency, and growing proprietary brands. SiteOne invests in operational initiatives, category management, digital transformation, and sustainability, with a focus on customer service, local market leadership, and associate development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of landscape supplies and related products to professional customers, with additional income from value-added consultative services and loyalty programs. The company also earns commissions on agency sales and offers proprietary branded products, with less than 1% of sales from wholesale distribution to retailers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SiteOne is the only national distributor with a full product line in the highly fragmented landscape supply industry, where most competitors are regional or local. Major competitors include Heritage Landscape Supply Group (Home Depot), Ewing, Harrell’s, Horizon Distributors (Pool Corp), Target Specialty Products, BWI, Outdoor Living Supply, Central Turf and Irrigation Supply, and Howard Fertilizer and Chemical. SiteOne’s scale, breadth, and service differentiate it from smaller, local rivals.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2024, SiteOne reported net sales of $4.54 billion, a 6% increase over 2023, primarily driven by acquisitions. Gross profit was $1.56 billion, with net income attributable to SiteOne of $123.6 million (down 29% year-over-year due to commodity price deflation and lower price realization). The company continues to grow through acquisitions and organic initiatives, maintaining a strong balance sheet and liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SiteOne’s value proposition centers on its comprehensive product portfolio, national branch network, proprietary brands, and high-touch customer service model. The company differentiates itself through local expertise, consultative services, reliable delivery, and digital tools, offering landscape professionals a one-stop solution with broad availability, convenience, and technical support.
